interpretation.coverageMeaning: the final leaf boxes form an exact full cover of each of the seven original failed (d,s) parent boxes
interpretation.limitation: this is full-cover refinement only inside seven selected natural boxes; it remains corroborative and cannot replace the uniform Clenshaw contour certificate
interpretation.successMeaning: a parent is resolved only when every leaf in its full-cover dyadic partition has a nonzero Evans box and positive denominator/tube margins

method.failurePolicy: refine every failed level-one child once; preserve every failed level-two child as inconclusive without shrinking or relaxed criteria
method.partition: complete 2-by-2 dyadic split in exact rational (d,s)
